final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.arcref AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(1.0 * s.boxx / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT funding_source, AVG(avg_ratio) AS funding_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY funding_source) SELECT step1.project_id, step1.funding_source, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.funding_avg AS difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step1.funding_source = step2.funding_source COLLATE BINARY WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.funding_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
